# StealthEye Agent OS full public LLM context

StealthEye Agent OS is a public-safe foundation for a schema-gated, workflow-compiled, memory-backed, eval-driven autonomous agent runtime. It is intended to support authorized online work through APIs, custom apps/MCP tools, future isolated BrowserOps, durable workers, Guard policy gates, receipts, replay, and evals.

## Operating model

Jamie grants high autonomy inside mission-scoped authority envelopes for low-risk delegated work. The system should avoid repeated approval for scoped reads, branch work, PRs, CI inspection, allowed CI repair, fixture-only previews, and receipt generation. It must stop or escalate for destruction, raw secrets, money/billing, production deploy/data mutation, production-impacting migration, auth/security-critical change, protected branch mutation, force push/history rewrite, CI/test/security weakening, material external send, legal commitment, credentialed browsing, and platform-required confirmation.

## Build 8

Build 8 adds two separate deliverables: `@stealtheye/browserops` and `scripts/stealtheye-build.mjs`.

BrowserOps models browser sessions, page observations, evidence references, action policies, action plans, Guard preflight, and Worker Fleet handoff templates. It does not execute Playwright, launch a browser, visit real websites, submit forms, upload files, use credentials, store cookies, make purchases, send material externally, mutate production, or perform destructive actions.

The build automation engine reads phase specs and creates/checks deterministic generated state under `docs/generated/`. It includes a conservative public-safe/no-live scanner for generated files and BrowserOps fixtures. It is not a deployment tool, durable workflow runtime, SBOM/provenance generator, or substitute for full security review.

## Verification

```bash
pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
node scripts/stealtheye-build.mjs scripts/phases/build-008-browserops.mjs --check
```
